name: 17320 · Fairfield, PA
findings: ZIP 17320 (Fairfield) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17320 (Fairfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
